io.quarkus.hibernate.orm.deployment.Hibe.deprecated: Use {@code quarkus.hibernate-orm.fetch.batch-size} to configure the batch fetch size.
io.quarkus.hibernate.orm.deployment.Hibe.description:
The size of the batches used when loading entities and collections.

`-1` means batch loading is disabled.

io.quarkus.hibernate.orm.deployment.Hibe.deprecated: Use {@code quarkus.hibernate-orm.fetch.max-depth} to configure the maximum fetch depth.
io.quarkus.hibernate.orm.deployment.Hibe.description:
The maximum depth of outer join fetch tree for single-ended associations (one-to-one, many-to-one).

A `0` disables default outer join fetching.
